meta.method: Open-source research only (Task 03 rules): official MoE/LASG statements, commissioners, assembly members, and news from 6 months before each site flood through 2026-10-17. Quotes ≤ 25 words, verbatim. Due dates only when the source states a date or duration, or names a contract period. status, status_reason and last_checked left null. No imagery updates.
meta.notes: Officials' claims are recorded as updates with finding claimed_done or claimed_ongoing; done is used only when a journalist reports seeing completion. Several sites have no site-specific official structure commitment in the search window.
unresolved: labora: no official build/drain commitment found (resident complaints only)
marina-drainage: no dated Marina drainage works; Omotosho 17 Jul 2021 said channels were in good condition, not a construction promise
alapere-ogudu: LASTMA reported road construction in place; no official completion or drainage promise found
ibeju-lekki-expy: resident asked Ibeju-Lekki LG to clear drains; no official commitment found
lekki-epe-rehab: rehab reported ongoing 3 Jul 2024; no official completion date found (later Bonny Camp–Admiralty 35-day job excluded)
agric-bridge: original award/promise date not found; inbound opening of 8 Sep 2026 is recorded
alpha-beach-156: Wahab 5 Jul 2024 X post is headline_only
ikorodu-dammed: contractor name still not found

sources.outlet: Lagos State Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources
Lagos State Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources

meta.imagery_updates: Imagery updates added by reviewer (Claude) on 2026-10-17 after inspecting the referenced images; news/official updates by Task 22.
review_notes: Removed 2026-06 claimed_done updates from agungi-collector-build-202406: both sources concern demolitions on Agungi/Ajiran and never mention the collector (checked 2026-10-17).
Removed ikorodu-dammed-other-202508: an appeal to a contractor during the storm, not a public commitment; due date preceded the date made.
Quotes verified verbatim 2026-10-17: MoE Agungi 2026 demolition, Guardian Oko-Oba 2022 (via Wayback), Vanguard Sangotedo 48-hour notice, Nairametrics System 63b, plus Task 17 checks.
